findings.title: Per-issue event lookup in comment body generation causes N+1 queries
findings.body: get_environment_info calls issue.get_recommended_event() (a Snuba/nodestore lookup) and get_environment() for every issue while building the PR comment. With up to 5 issues this adds several extra queries on each comment task. The broad `except Exception` also hides real failures and logs them only at info level.

findings.title: New comment template drops culprit and changes markdown list formatting
findings.body: The template ends in "\n" and is joined with "\n", so each item is followed by a blank line and the list renders as loose paragraphs with extra trailing whitespace. The `culprit` subtitle was also removed. The ISSUE_TITLE_MAX_LENGTH truncation can cut the title mid markdown-token, for example inside backticks or emphasis.

findings.title: Editing already-merged migrations to no-ops
findings.body: Migrations 0917 and 0920 are rewritten to do nothing, and their tests are deleted. Any environment that already ran the original bodies keeps the data they produced. The comment says the migration was never run, but that cannot be guaranteed. The comment also refers to a 0921 migration that is not part of this diff.

findings.title: Default autofix automation tuning changed from low to off
findings.body: This changes the default behaviour for every project without an explicit option value. Autofix automation silently turns off for existing projects that relied on the default. The change is bundled into an unrelated PR with no migration or release note.

findings.title: Truthiness check on initial_data misses age=0 or timestamp=0
findings.body: validate_timestamp and validate_age use `if self.initial_data.get(...)`, which is falsy for 0. A report with age=0 plus a timestamp passes validation even though the specs are meant to be mutually exclusive. Use `in` or `is not None` instead.

findings.title: Error events are paired with the wrong ids and the zero-ts default breaks ordering
findings.body: `zip(error_ids, events.values())` assumes get_multi returns results in the same order as error_ids, which a dict does not guarantee. Events can therefore be mislabeled, and the id field is unreliable. Missing timestamps default to 0.0, which sorts those errors first. The endpoint also now runs a Snuba query before pagination, and request.user.id is passed even for anonymous users.

findings.title: Analytics recorded before the feature flag check
findings.body: analytics.record runs before the `organizations:preprod-artifact-assemble` feature check. Events are therefore emitted for orgs that do not have the feature, and the request is then rejected with 404.

findings.title: Table widget renders empty data under the feature flag
findings.body: When `use-table-widget-visualization` is enabled, TableWidgetVisualization receives hardcoded `columns=[]` and empty `tableData`. Every table widget shows empty, ignoring result.data and result.meta. The `loading` state is also dropped.
